question: Where was the All India Inter-University Volleyball Championship 2025 held from 6-10 January?
solution:
The correct answer is __**St. Thomas College, Pala**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The **All India Inter-University Volleyball Championship 2025** for men was hosted by **St. Thomas College, Pala**, located in the **Kottayam** district of **Kerala**. 
• The prestigious sporting event was conducted over five days, starting from **6 January 2025** and concluding on **10 January 2025**. 
• The tournament was organized under the auspices of **Mahatma Gandhi University**, **Kottayam**, which is the affiliating university for **St. Thomas College**. 
• This championship brought together the top-performing university teams from the four geographical zones of **India** (North, South, East, and West) to compete for the national university title. 
• The event is a significant fixture in the Indian university sports calendar, aimed at fostering athletic excellence and identifying promising talent for the **national volleyball team**. ***Hence, the correct answer is St. Thomas College, Pala.*** 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **St. Thomas College, Pala:** 
• Established in **1950**, it is one of the premier higher education institutions in **Kerala**. 
• The college has a long-standing reputation for sports excellence, particularly in **Volleyball** and **Athletics**, having produced several **Olympians** and **national-level** athletes for **India**. 
• The hosting of the **2025** championship highlights the college's advanced sports infrastructure, including high-quality courts and residential facilities for visiting athletes. 
• **Association of Indian Universities (AIU):** 
• The **AIU** is the governing body responsible for organizing **Inter-University** sports competitions across the country. 
• It serves as an umbrella organization for over **800** universities in **India**, facilitating academic and cultural exchange alongside sports. 
• Success in **AIU** championships is often a prerequisite for students to gain admission under sports quotas in professional courses and secure jobs in **government organizations**. 
• **Mahatma Gandhi University:** 
• Commonly known as **MG University**, it was established in **1983** in **Kottayam**, **Kerala**. 
• It has been a frequent host for various **National** and **South Zone Inter-University** tournaments, maintaining a strong focus on physical education. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Tournament Structure:** 
• The **All India** stage usually involves **16 teams** that have qualified as the top four finishers from each of the four **Zonal** (North, South, East, West) championships. 
• The matches are played in a **league-cum-knockout** format, ensuring that only the most consistent teams reach the final rounds. 
• **Volleyball Culture in Kerala:** 
• The state of **Kerala** is considered a powerhouse of **Volleyball** in **India**, with the sport enjoying immense popularity in rural and semi-urban areas like **Pala**. 
• Hosting the **All India Inter-University** meet in **Kerala** often draws large crowds, reflecting the state's deep passion for the game. 
• **Dates and Duration:** 
• The **2025** edition held in **January** aligns with the peak season for university sports in **India**, preceding the **Khelo India University Games**. </ul
